table.name: documents
table.summary: A master table storing metadata and classification details for various documents, including their type, associated project, creation date, and descriptive names.

document_id.name: document_id
document_id.meaning: Unique identifier for each document record.

document_type_code.name: document_type_code
document_type_code.meaning: A short alphanumeric code representing the category or nature of the document (e.g., CV, BK).

document_date.name: document_date
document_date.meaning: The timestamp when the document was created, updated, or processed.
